decisions.docsAuthority: src/mcp/tool-registry.ts + script/verify-tool-docs.ts (curated doc) are the single source; docs/tools/bb_edit.md is a generated artifact
decisions.releaseGate: verify-quality-gate.ts (the E1-E12 verifiers wired) + verify-evidence.ts B3 invariant (verified requires failed=0 AND negativeCases>=1); proven by tamper test
decisions.evidenceInputs: validation/m13/results/e1..e11.json plus e13.json (batch) must all exist, validate, and claim verified for bb_edit to be release-eligible

limitations: Docs byte-freshness is proven by the generator's own verify mode SCOPED to bb_edit, not by a duplicated render.
This gate covers bb_edit only; every other tool has its own verifier.

The hand-page checks are phrase-level: they prove the page STATES each contract and that the enumerations it must match (the accepted sets, the entry cap) come from the enforcing constants, not that every sentence on the page is checked.
